evals.prompt: Use the S.EE CLI to check what domains my API key can use, without revealing the key.
evals.expected_output: Runs or recommends `see domains --json`, `see text domains --json`, and `see file domains --json`; checks only whether SEE_API_KEY is set; does not print the API key value.

evals.prompt: Upload this PNG as an image host URL with see and tell me how to delete it later.
evals.expected_output: Uses `see file upload <file> --json`, returns the uploaded `url` or `page`, preserves the returned hash/key/delete information, and explains deletion with `see file delete <key> --json`.

evals.prompt: Create a short URL for https://example.com with slug docs and JSON output.
evals.expected_output: Uses the installed command shape `see shorturl create https://example.com --slug docs --json`; does not use the stale `see url create` command unless the local CLI confirms that alias.

evals.prompt: Share the contents of notes.md as a syntax-highlighted paste called Release Notes.
evals.expected_output: Uses `see text create --file notes.md --title "Release Notes" --type markdown --json` or an equivalent command, and notes that text entries can also read from stdin.

evals.prompt: I need the full usage and flags for the S.EE CLI.
evals.expected_output: Consults the skill reference and reports the top-level commands, global flags, and subcommands for shorturl, text, and file, including create/update/delete/upload/history/download-url where applicable.
